original_hook: 🚨 Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub 📰 Jack Dorsey’s Block has applied for a US trust bank charter to provide federally supervised Bitcoin custody, according to Cointelegraph. The proposed charter creates a regulated custody framework without the leverage risks of deposit-taking banks. While $BTC compresses near $78,950 in a tight 2.7% daily range, institutional plumbing is quietly upgrading behind the scenes. Direct federal supervision removes counterparty friction for large capital allocators long before price reflects the shift. Bullish, bearish, or wait Is this a real repricing event or temporary headline noise?
